_readme: EDIT THIS FILE to change the game's words, then run: python build_voice.py

_fields.sentence: a short sentence using the word, so he hears it in context
_fields.challenge: true for harder bonus words (worth 3 stars instead of 2). Optional, defaults to false.
_fields.wrong: OPTIONAL. Three plausible misspellings for the multiple-choice stages. Leave it out and sensible ones are generated for you.
_fields.picture: OPTIONAL. Name of a drawing to reuse. Leave it out and the word gets a letter card instead.

words.sentence: I gave the ball to him.
I dip my chip in the sauce.
The pig rolls in the mud.
That kid is my best friend.
There is a rift in the big rock.
Do not spit out your food.
